payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort array; for each index i, compute curm = max of other elements; set target M = max(curm, ceil(sum/(n-1))); answer = max_i ((n-1)*M - sum).
payload.rationale: The solution iterates greedily over each box as the chosen one, uses sorted order to easily get the maximum among remaining boxes, and applies a mathematical target to satisfy both divisibility and minimal extra blocks.
